variant.author: Asphodel
variant.changelog:
Hotfix for inventory/retainer UI ownership.

- Stop retainer recovery from closing or acting on normal player inventory addons.
- Require retainer-specific bag addons when operating on retainer bags.
- Make automation stop also cancel any active scanner token so idle plugins do not keep UI helper behavior alive.
